versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-opc-advisor 0.0.2

- Clarified: Output is conversational and must not use file/deliverable language; added explicit instruction to never use file-writing or shell tools for recommendations.
- Routing logic tightened: Now requires explicit deployment-status AND migration-intent for direct A2 (migration) flow; a bare migration-intent triggers the entry probe — no direct recommendation allowed in ambiguous cases.
- Hardened user-facing phrasing: Internal routing terms (A1/A2/branch/etc) are strictly prohibited in chat responses; examples and warnings added.
- Documentation: Improved explanations, workflow references, and clarified blocking/interaction rules to avoid premature recommendations.
- Removed obsolete file (skill-card.md); updated and expanded references for selection and migration workflows.

alibabacloud-opc-advisor 0.0.1 Changelog

- Initial release of the Alibaba Cloud OPC Advisor skill.
- Provides SKU/package recommendations (with exact monthly price and purchase URL) for one-person companies, focusing on non-technical solo founders.
- Distinct routing for new deployments versus migrations from platforms like Vercel/Netlify/AWS.
- Strict rules to block out-of-scope (company-scale/high-traffic) requests and decline with explicit reasoning.
- User interaction fully in Chinese, with clear boundaries and mandatory two-step questionnaire for reliable sizing.
- Recommendation-only: deployment actions are handled by the companion alibabacloud-opc-deploy skill.
